latestRun.summary: Completed individual weak-signal source-excerpt assessments for the exact 463 priority records: 369 OpenAI families, 85 mixed-uncertainty rationales and nine revised records. Decisions: 375 Superhuman, 75 Difficult, 13 Expected. Changed categories for 405 records and rationales for all 463. Corpus-wide Superhuman count is now 501, including 478 best-estimate placements and 23 tentative AI-frontier placements.
latestRun.coverageNote: Assessment-only pass, not a new discovery search or proof-verification run. Individually read each retained primary-source claim and the relevant AI disclosures; rechecked the official OpenAI repository and release announcement. This is not a reread of all constituent papers, proof checking or artifact replay. Continuous evidence coverage remains 2026-08-20; inherited search gaps are unchanged. Historical difficulty is conditional on the exact reported claim and separate from correctness, novelty, scope and material AI contribution. Restricted cases, already-human-solved targets and conditional results were distinguished. OpenAI material attribution is a best-guess inference from its explicit model-produced-results disclosure applied to each catalogued family; family-level generation histories remain unreconstructed. Existing provisional flags, strict P/A/S/R classifications and verification metadata were not upgraded.
